BJP MP Raises Security Concerns Over Elon Musk's Starlink in India

Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) Member of Parliament Nishikant Dubey has raised concerns that Elon Musk's satellite internet service, Starlink, poses security challenges for India. The row escalates as Starlink aims to offer affordable services in India, reportedly days before the initial public offering (IPO) of Reliance Industries chairman Mukesh Ambani's Jio. Other satellite internet providers like Jio and OneWeb have reportedly been waiting longer to enter the Indian market. The economics of broadband services in India, including those offered by Starlink, Jio, Airtel, and BSNL, are being examined.
